<!-- head-1: body_md -->
Let \((r_1, \ldots, r_N)\) be an admissible correlation vector with
associated Toeplitz matrices \(A_n \succeq 0\), and let \(x_n\) denote
the SH coordinate at lag \(n\). Then for every \(n\) at which the
previous Toeplitz matrix \(A_n\) is positive definite,
\[
  \boxed{x_n = \alpha_n},
\]
where \(\alpha_n\) is the \(n\)-th partial autocorrelation coefficient
of the sequence.
<!-- end head-1 -->
